properties.description: Pins a Component's computed build reading (DesignGraph::component_build, served as built_reading) on in-memory designs: all allocated capabilities built reads built with the stored status unchanged; no built evidence reads not_built; part of the function built, or a file while a hosted capability is unbuilt, reads partly_built; a part with only a passing check of its own reads built; a withdrawn capability is not counted; and understated_status names exactly the planned components whose reading is not not_built.
properties.name: tests/built_work_reads_as_built.rs
